name: VMD
summary: Molecular visualization and trajectory-analysis desktop application.

steps: Read the official VMD download and license pages and choose a release for the user's operating system and graphics environment.
Obtain the platform-specific installer or archive from the maintainer under the user's own account if required; inspect the package before installation.
Install only to a user-approved location and verify that the graphical application starts. Treat any headless/cluster use as a separate platform-specific configuration.
install.verify_note: Launch VMD and check its version and graphics initialization. Test trajectory loading only with a user-approved sample.

notes: VMD is free of charge but has its own license. GUI and graphics-driver checks cannot be represented by the current automatic CLI installer.
